candidates.title: DuoServe-MoE: Dual-Phase Expert Prefetch and Cache Scheduling for Efficient MoE LLM Inference
candidates.reason: prefillのdense expert activationとdecodeのsparse activationを分け、prefillはtwo-stream CUDA pipeline、decodeはlayer-level predictorでexpert prefetchする。4-bit Mixtralでend-to-end latency 1.42〜7.54倍改善、peak memoryをfull modelの15%に抑える。

candidates.title: Efficient Multi-Adapter LLM Serving via Cross-Model KV-Cache Reuse with Activated LoRA
candidates.reason: base modelとLoRA adapter間でprefix KVを再利用するためbase-aligned block hashingとactivation-aware maskingをvLLMへ統合。multi-adapter pipelineでend-to-end最大58倍、TTFT 100倍超改善を報告し、cross-model KV reuseの実装系統として重要。

candidates.title: AGENTSERVESIM: A Hardware-aware Simulator for Multi-Turn LLM Agent Serving
candidates.reason: multi-turn agent servingのturn dependency、tool gap、cross-turn KV locality、HBM/DRAM/CXL residencyをprogram granularityで再現するhardware-aware simulator。実機主要指標を6%以内で再現し、agent serving policy探索の評価基盤として有用。
